def nanquantile_hazen_rows(X):
    X = np.ascontiguousarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
    C, M = X.shape
    nan = np.isnan(X)
    n = M - nan.sum(axis=1)                       # valid counts
    Xs = np.sort(np.where(nan, np.inf, X), axis=1)
    h = (n + 1) * 0.9 - 1.0
    j = np.floor(h).astype(np.int64)
    j = np.clip(j, 0, np.maximum(n - 1, 0))
    g = h - j

    v1 = Xs[rows, j]

    v2 = Xs[rows, jj2]
    use = (g > 0) & (j + 1 < n)
    res = np.where(use, v1 + g * (v2 - v1), v1)
    res = np.where(n > 0, res, np.nan)
    return res

for n in [2, 3, 5, 10, 121]:
    x = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)

    # candidate formulas (0-based h)
    cands = {
        'nq-0.5': n*0.9 - 0.5,
        '(n-1)q+0.5': (n-1)*0.9 + 0.5,
        '(n+1)q-1': (n+1)*0.9 - 1,
        '(n-1)q': (n-1)*0.9,
        '(n+1/3)q-1/3': (n+1/3)*0.9 - 1/3,
        '(n+1)q-0.375': (n+1)*0.9 - 0.375,
    }
    def val(h):
        h = min(max(h, 0.0), n-1.0000001)
        j = int(h); g = h - j
        if g < 1e-15 or j >= n-1:
            return x[j]
        return x[j] + g*(x[j+1]-x[j])
    got = {k: val(v) for k, v in cands.items()}
    best = [k for k in got if abs(got[k] - v) < 1e-12]
